name: Check dtiInit Orientation
summary: Reports the orientation (neurological or radiological) of a dtiInit-aligned DWI NIfTI image with FSL fslorient; a quality-control utility that produces no new image data.
description: Reads the aligned DWI path from the dtiInit dt6.json, runs fslorient on it and writes the reported orientation (NEUROLOGICAL or RADIOLOGICAL) to product.json. It relies on a host FSL installation (no container) and legacy IU HPC environment variables, so it may not run on current resources.

inputs.description: dtiInit output; the aligned DWI listed in dt6.json (files.alignedDwRaw) is checked.

outputs.description: Placeholder output; the orientation result is reported in product.json rather than as files.
